crossRefs.note: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…
He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

parallels.note: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, and five thousand…

translations.web: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.
translations.bsb: And some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the project 20,000 darics of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.
translations.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
translations.asv: And some of the heads of fathers' houses gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.
